rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Miniature.
Registration name: Jet Trail
rows.Origin:
Bred by Ralph S. Moore (United States, 1964).
Introduced in Australia by Roy H. Rumsey Pty. Ltd. in 1967 as 'Jet Trail'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. 40 to 50 petals. Average diameter 1.5". Small, very full (41+ petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
